about_the_game:
■Demo Features

In the demo, you can enjoy both the single-player mode “Solo Survival” and the online versus mode “Arena.”

※The online versus mode “Arena” will be playable starting with the major October update.

■Single-Player Mode

Experience the core gameplay of “Solo Survival” and enjoy roguelite × puzzle mechanics!

  • Playable from Stage 1-1 to 1-5

  • Only one character is available

  • Limited number of relics

  • Relics are fixed and not randomized

※In the full version, you can play without restrictions.

■online versus mode

※The online versus mode “Arena” will be playable starting with the major October update.

Test your skills in the battle royale of up to 8 players, even in the demo!

  • Challenge a battle royale with up to 8 players

  • Character abilities are limited in the demo

※In the full version, each character has unique abilities.
※An internet connection is required for online play.

■Gameplay Highlights

  • Addictive puzzle mechanics

  • High replayability from the roguelite × puzzle combination

  • Satisfying fatality animations after battles

  • Compete in battle royale mode with players around the world

—Experience the wit and strategic depth of Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle- in the demo!—

short_description: This is a roguelike puzzle game where quick thinking determines your survival. Every run offers a fresh experience based on your choices—deck-building, puzzle-solving, and exploration all shape your journey. Master the mysterious stone tablets and uncover the secrets hidden within ancient ruins!
